findings.passage: We have also seen numerous bills claiming to add greater security and protections to our elections. These measures, in our opinion, are not based on any objective, data driven, evidence-based assessment of the issue but solely with the intention to undermine Black voters and other communities of concern.
findings.note: Statement issued by him as chair of the Georgia Legislative Black Caucus policy committee, about the roughly 30 voting and election bills of the 2021 session. It speaks of election-security bills in general and does not name ID or citizenship proof. The same statement says the committee strongly supports HB 113 (same-day registration and voting).
